settings.title: What it covers
settings.content: Fills the footwell so the back seat becomes one flat surface, then covers the seat backs, both inner doors, and the floor. Nothing gets through to your interior.

settings.title: Fit
settings.content: Fits most SUVs, trucks with a back bench, and larger crossovers and wagons. Standard sedans work with a shorter platform section. Not for compact two-doors. Email us your year, make and model if you are unsure.

settings.question: Will it fit my car?
settings.answer: Fits most SUVs, trucks with a back bench, and larger crossovers and wagons. Standard sedans work with a shorter platform section. Not for compact two-doors. Email us your year, make and model if you are unsure.

settings.question: Will my dog feel boxed in?
settings.answer: No. Mesh side windows keep it open — your dog sees out and gets airflow, and you can see your dog.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Unclip it, shake it out, then wipe or hose it down and let it air dry. Machine washable cold when it needs a proper clean.

settings.question: How long is shipping?
settings.answer: Most orders ship within 2 business days. Delivery is usually 1–2 weeks across Canada and the US, with tracking.

settings.question: Is it a crash restraint?
settings.answer: No. It protects your seats and gives your dog a flat surface to lie on. It is not crash-tested. Use a proper harness or crate if you want crash protection.

settings.question: What if it doesn’t work out?
settings.answer: Send it back within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. It can show honest use, but it needs to be clean and dry.
